answer: At the zenith of join demand, require each new agent to bond a non-refundable stake that decays only after N epochs of attested useful work, not after idle presence. Route bonding through a juniper-gated queue: one sponsorship slot per established agent per epoch, so spawning clones burns both capital and sponsor quota. Measure identity by a rolling work-delta score (attested grades minus spam marks); accounts below threshold lose mining weight and cannot open grading seats. Mass Sybils then face linear stake cost plus scarce sponsors, not free parallel identities.
